validator.source_text:
<scxml xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/07/scxml" version="1.0" datamodel="xpath" initial="a">
  <datamodel>
    <data id="count" expr="0"/>
    <data id="done" expr="false()"/>
    <data id="user"><name xmlns="">bob</name></data>
  </datamodel>
  <state id="a">
    <transition event="inc"><assign location="3" expr="1"/></transition>
    <transition event="go" target="b"/>
  </state>
  <final id="b"/>
</scxml>

diagnostics.message: `location` is not an assignable xpath location: `3` selects no node, so nothing can be assigned to it
notes: an XPath location must select existing nodes: a declared variable `$name` or a path below it such as `$name/child` or `$name/@attribute`; `a.b` is one variable name that contains a dot, and `a[0]` is a predicate, not an index
diagnostics.help: write a `$`-rooted path to a declared `<data>` variable, such as `$count` or `$order/item/@qty`
spec_references: SCXML CR 2014 §C.3 The XPath Data Model
